summary: Wrote homily.tex, the spoken body (1,446 words, about 11.1-12.1 minutes by arithmetic; no timed delivery) and the terminal note with References for an adult parish assembly on 18 October 2026. It follows the second reading (the forgiven debtor) sharpened by the first reading's enemy behind the enemy, turning on the plea repeated word for word (Mt 18:26, 29), de cordibus vestris and Eph 6:12, with the Introit, Offertory, Communion, Collect and Postcommunion joined. Every quoted span was checked against the tracked sources and the registered 1861 scan. The shared generation timestamp and contribution were updated, all three documents rebuilt cleanly (homily 3 pages, study 37, concise 12, concise aux unchanged), every content, preflight, component and metadata check passes, and the production audit records the stage.
